heading: Public servant concerned in sale not to purchase or bid for property.
text: A public servant having any duty to perform in connection with the sale of any property under this Code shall not purchase or bid for the property.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
